community_list_entries.name: MemEye: A Visual-Centric Evaluation Framework for Multimodal Agent Memory

phase1_classification.kind_reason: Main contribution is a new visual-centric benchmark (8 life-scenario tasks) for long-term multimodal agent memory. The paper describes images spread across multi-session conversations, plus state-revision questions. It evaluates 13 memory methods across 4 VLM backbones.
